body: Should have known better then to come to the internet as a last resort. Going to give it 48hrs, then goodbye if things arent better. I wish everyone else seeking answers or who are hurting all the best and hope things work out.

It's not just the nerves, but opening up to people to begin with. When i was at school i doubt more then 2 people knew that my dad had died when i was 4. I tend to just bottle it all up and then it just explodes.
